description: Enter cigarettes per day, pack price, and quit date to see money saved so far plus 1- and 5-year projections.

faqs.a: Days since your quit date × (cigarettes per day ÷ 20) × pack price. Future projections use the same daily saving rate.
A pack-a-day smoker at typical prices saves thousands per year — the 1-year and 5-year projections show the full picture.
faqs.q: How much can I really save?

faqs.a: Yes — the calculation is pure arithmetic on the numbers you enter; no judgment, just motivation.
faqs.q: I slipped up — is this still useful?

howto: Enter how many cigarettes you smoked per day.
Enter the price of a 20-cigarette pack.
See money saved to date plus 1-year and 5-year projections.
title: Smoking Savings Calculator
